entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 249 of 2023 registered at Police Station Narwar, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 341, 324, 323, 506, 34, 307, 326, 325 and 294 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Present FIR is the counter-blast of the FIR registered at Crime No.322 of 2022 under Section 376/506 of IPC which was lodged by co-accused Mulayam Singh.
It is further submitted that the incident occurred when the witnesses were returning back from the Court after giving evidence.
As per allegation, applicant - accused was having lathi.
His case is at parity with co-accused Layakram and Premnarayan who have been granted bail by this Court by order dated 20.12.2023 passed in MCRC No.54082 of 2023.
Further argument is that applicant is in custody since 03.10.2023.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.

Applicant is t h e permanent Chuttu @ Karan @ Karn vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172621481/
1 resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.) having no criminal antecedents and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.

sentences.text: Hence, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P er contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Chuttu @ Karan @ Karn vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172621481/
